_doc: Gift families (Docs/Design/43-gifts.md). The server reads it for the rules and sends the creator the player-facing part. kind: work, instant, gathered, channelled, reaction, fightlong, passive, shape, twoturn. mana: up front; perTurn: while held; perTile: for each painted tile. work: true marks a passive that helps at work, not in a fight. Every number is a placeholder.

normal.name: Normal
normal.best: No Gift. Strength through skill, training, gear and friends. A seasoned Normal fighter is a match for most Gifted wolves.

gifted.name: Gifted
gifted.best: A small, real Gift. Best for industry and for supporting a party: better work, and a fight's odds turned your side's way. No magical damage.

quickened.name: Quickened
quickened.best: A Gift at a frightening scale. Best for magical combat. Rare, feared, and watched: Wardens take an interest in Quickened magic that others see.

gifted.best: Smiths, cooks and potters. In a fight, the medic who stops bleeding and finds hidden foes by their heat.

abilities.name: Forge Heat
abilities.summary: Keeps a forge, kiln or oven at working heat without fuel: better smithing, firing and cooking.

abilities.name: Kindle
abilities.summary: Lights a fire on damp wood or in the rain.

abilities.name: Cauterize
abilities.summary: Stops an ally's bleeding, by touch. It hurts: their bar is set back a little.

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.summary: A flash in an adjacent foe's face knocks their bar back.

abilities.name: Smother to Smoke
abilities.summary: Turns a fire or brush into smoke that blocks sight for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Warm Through
abilities.summary: Takes away an ally's cold and soaked penalties for the fight.

abilities.name: Heat Sense
abilities.summary: Senses body heat within 6 tiles: shows warm wolves, hidden or not.

quickened.best: The destroyer: cones, lances and walls of fire. Sees through stealth.
quickened.overreach: Overheating: the burn to itself doubles.

abilities.name: Flamethrower
abilities.summary: A 5-tile cone of fire that sets wolves burning.

abilities.name: Heat Lance
abilities.summary: A 4-tile line of heat into one wolf; metal armour on the zone it hits sets them burning too.

abilities.name: Blastwave
abilities.summary: A burst that hurts everyone adjacent, allies too, and shoves them back.

abilities.name: Wall of Fire
abilities.summary: Paint up to 10 tiles of fire anywhere within 10; they burn for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Heat Sense
abilities.summary: Sees hidden wolves within 12 tiles, through smoke and sneaking. No blow lands harder from the side or behind.

gifted.best: Masons, potters and miners. In a fight, makes the ground work for your side and feels sneakers' footsteps.
gifted.tell: Braces bare paws on the ground: wraps or boots defeat it, and never on wood.

abilities.name: Clay Hand
abilities.summary: Better pottery and masonry.

abilities.name: Stone Sense
abilities.summary: Finds ore seams, flawed stone and weak walls.

abilities.name: Loosen Ground
abilities.summary: A tile turns soft: double stamina to cross, and a chance to stumble.

abilities.name: Firm Footing
abilities.summary: Packs an ally's tile: they can't be shoved, and guard better on it.

abilities.name: Feel Footfalls
abilities.summary: Shows every wolf moving within 6 tiles, sneakers included.

quickened.best: The fortress: walls, fissures and thrown stone, armoured on every side.
quickened.tell: Braces its paws, even through wraps; never on wood.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.summary: A tile erupts under a wolf: hurt, knocked down, and its next move lost.

abilities.name: Hurl Stone
abilities.summary: Tears up a rock and throws it at a wolf up to 10 tiles away.

abilities.name: Fissure
abilities.summary: Paint up to 10 tiles of split ground: wolves on it are hurt and fall, and no one crosses for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Stone Wall
abilities.summary: Paint up to 5 tiles of wall that blocks movement and sight until broken.

abilities.name: Stone Armor
abilities.summary: Heavy armour on every side for the fight: no blow lands harder from the side or behind. Slower.

gifted.best: Farmers, tanners and dyers, and mending injuries between fights. In a fight, puts out fire and blinds foes.
gifted.tell: Needs free water within 2 tiles or an open waterskin.
gifted.limit: About a bucket at a time.

abilities.name: Draw Water
abilities.summary: Irrigation, filling, and washing hides for tanning and dyeing.

abilities.name: Dowse
abilities.summary: Finds water under the ground.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.summary: Tends an ally's injury so it heals half again as fast. Once a day per injury.

abilities.name: Douse
abilities.summary: Puts out an ally's burning, or a burning tile.

abilities.name: Slick
abilities.summary: Wets a tile: on stone or paving, a chance to slip.

abilities.name: Splash Eyes
abilities.summary: An adjacent foe's next attack is less likely to hit.

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.summary: Washes an ally's scent off and clears dust or smoke from their eyes.

quickened.best: The controller: waves, floods, and freezing the wolves caught in them. Shrugs off fire.
quickened.tell: Water within 4 tiles, rain or wet ground.

abilities.name: Pressure Jet
abilities.summary: A 5-tile jet that hurts the first wolf and shoves it back.

abilities.name: Wave
abilities.summary: A wave 3 wide rolls 4 tiles: everyone shoved and knocked down, and shallow water left behind.

abilities.name: Freeze
abilities.summary: A wolf standing in shallow water freezes in place: no move next turn.

abilities.name: Flood
abilities.summary: A 3×3 area becomes shallow water: everyone else slowed, fire weakened.

abilities.name: Water Screen
abilities.summary: For the fight, no blow lands harder from the side or behind, and fire does a quarter of its damage.

gifted.best: Millers, farmers and smiths. The hunter's and sneak's friend: turns the wind against noses.
gifted.tell: A long breath in, then out.
gifted.limit: A breeze: only light things move.

abilities.name: Winnow and Dry
abilities.summary: Faster threshing, milling, and drying of herbs, hides and laundry.

abilities.name: Bellows
abilities.summary: Draws a forge hotter: better smithing.

abilities.name: Turn the Wind
abilities.summary: Keeps your side's scent from enemy noses, or carries theirs to yours.

abilities.name: Clear the Air
abilities.summary: Blows smoke or dust off a 3-tile area.

abilities.name: Back Breeze
abilities.summary: An ally's next move costs less stamina.

abilities.name: Air Blast
abilities.summary: Grit in a foe's eyes: they see less far for the rest of the fight.

quickened.best: The skirmisher: throws wolves about, steals their breath, moves twice as fast.
quickened.tell: A quick breath in and out.
quickened.limit: A gale over a few tiles.
quickened.overreach: Dizziness, or fainting for a turn.

abilities.name: Battering Gust
abilities.summary: Throws the first wolf in 5 tiles up to 3 back and down; worse if it hits a wall or a wolf.

abilities.name: Pressure Drop
abilities.summary: A 2×2 area: hurt, ears damaged, and half a bar lost.

abilities.name: Steal Breath
abilities.summary: Drains a foe's stamina and stops any held breath or hum.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.summary: Flings adjacent foes out, and the dust shortens their sight for the fight.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.summary: Moves twice as far as any other wolf.

gifted.best: Smiths, appraisers and repairers. In a fight, the drummer who speeds the side and hushes its steps.
gifted.tell: An open-throated hum others can hear.
gifted.cost: A hoarse voice and ringing ears.

abilities.name: Ring True
abilities.summary: Hears flaws in metal and stone: better crafting and appraising, and cheaper, quicker repairs.

abilities.name: Echo
abilities.summary: Maps a cave or mine.

abilities.name: Carry
abilities.summary: A herder's or crier's voice is heard far away.

abilities.name: Hush
abilities.summary: Allies within 2 tiles make no noise.

abilities.name: Throw Voice
abilities.summary: A noise from a chosen tile draws a foe's attention and turns them.

abilities.name: Steady Beat
abilities.summary: While you stay still, allies within 3 tiles fill their bars faster.

abilities.name: Whisper Thread
abilities.summary: Speak to one ally, unheard by anyone else.

quickened.best: The rogue: unseen and unsmelt, shatters weapons and ears.

abilities.name: Shatterhowl
abilities.summary: A 5-tile cone: hurt, deafened, and bars knocked back.

abilities.name: Resonance
abilities.summary: A foe's sword or armour rings until it cracks: worn down, and a sword can break.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.summary: A crack that knocks back everyone's bar within 2 tiles, allies and yourself too.

abilities.name: Dread Note
abilities.summary: A low note: weak foes flee, and the rest aim worse for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Battle Sense
abilities.summary: No scent at all, and almost no sound: the rogue.

families.name: Blinker
families.domain: Moving from one place, or state, to another.

gifted.best: Couriers and burglars. In a fight, the bodyguard who slips blows and steps in front of them.
gifted.tell: A hop: never while pinned, rooted or down.
gifted.cost: Dizziness: worse aim and dodge next turn.

abilities.name: Shortcut
abilities.summary: Blinks across a wall, a gap or a doorway.

abilities.name: Slip
abilities.summary: When attacked, blinks a tile back and the blow misses. Then rests 3 turns.

abilities.name: Interpose
abilities.summary: When an ally beside you is attacked, blinks in front and takes it on guard. Then rests 3 turns.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.summary: Blinks up to 3 tiles.

quickened.best: The assassin: strikes from behind, scatters foes, unmoors minds.
quickened.limit: Others, at a touch; minds, at a price.

abilities.name: Blink Strike
abilities.summary: Blinks behind a foe up to 6 tiles away and strikes from behind.

abilities.name: Chain Blink
abilities.summary: Strikes up to 3 foes in one turn, each a little lighter.

abilities.name: Displace
abilities.summary: Sends a foe you touch up to 4 tiles away.

abilities.name: Unmoor
abilities.summary: Pulls a foe's mind loose: their next turn lost, then disoriented.

abilities.name: Extract
abilities.summary: Blinks an ally within 4 tiles to safety, or swaps places with them.

gifted.best: Porters, armourers and masons. In a fight, lightens friends, burdens foes and lifts the fallen.
gifted.tell: Tapping feet, heard by anyone listening.
gifted.limit: One wolf or thing, a modest change.

abilities.name: Lighten Load
abilities.summary: Carry more for a while.

abilities.name: Settle
abilities.summary: Weapons and armour you make are hardier: they take more wear.

abilities.name: Lighten
abilities.summary: An ally's armour and load count lighter: further for less stamina.

abilities.name: Burden
abilities.summary: A foe's weapon and armour count heavier: everything costs more stamina.

abilities.name: Anchor
abilities.summary: An ally can't be shoved or knocked down.

abilities.name: Lift Up
abilities.summary: Lifts a downed ally to their feet from 5 tiles away, without healing them.

quickened.best: The crusher: lifts, drops and pulls wolves where it wants them.
quickened.tell: A faint tap of the feet.

abilities.name: Crush
abilities.summary: A foe grows terribly heavy: hurt each turn and barely able to move.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.summary: Lifts a foe (who loses their turns), then drops them hard. Hit the caster first and they fall short.

abilities.name: Well
abilities.summary: For 3 turns everyone within 3 tiles of a point is pulled toward it, allies too.

abilities.name: Hurl
abilities.summary: Throws a weightless foe up to 4 tiles.

abilities.name: Weightless
abilities.summary: For a turn, allies within 5 tiles move 3 further for no stamina.

gifted.best: Farmers and foragers. In a fight, calls out what's coming.
gifted.limit: Seconds ahead, of what it can see.

abilities.name: Weathereye
abilities.summary: Bigger harvests and forage.

abilities.name: Danger Sense
abilities.summary: Warns of an ambush ahead on the road.

abilities.name: Read the Line
abilities.summary: Shows a foe's next move and target.

abilities.name: Forewarn
abilities.summary: An ally dodges the next attack on them more easily.

abilities.name: Never Surprised
abilities.summary: Hidden attackers lose their opening on your side, and one sneaking foe is shown.

abilities.name: Glimpse the Order
abilities.summary: Shows the next few turns' order.

quickened.best: The duellist: can't be flanked, never misses its opening, marks a foe for death.
quickened.overreach: Losing track of now: worse aim, slower bar.

abilities.name: Seen Opening
abilities.summary: Your next attack can't miss and finds the least armoured spot.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.summary: The next attack on you misses, and you strike back.

abilities.name: Doom Mark
abilities.summary: For 3 turns a foe can't dodge, and everyone hits them more easily.

abilities.name: Shared Sight
abilities.summary: Allies within 3 tiles are forewarned every turn.

abilities.name: Critical Sight
abilities.summary: No blow lands harder from the side or behind, and you take less damage.

families.name: Death Walker
families.domain: Death and the remnants of the dead.

gifted.best: Senses death and what it leaves.
